name: Keep claims calm and specific
description: Avoid inflated superlatives and high-pressure hype in customer-facing copy.
pattern: world's best|best in the world|crush your goals|insane results

name: Use the approved product spelling
description: The approved product name is “Inkloom AI” with a space.

name: Substantiate absolute claims
description: Absolute and performance claims need an approved source. This demo does not connect to a source repository.
replacement: Add an approved source for human verification, or revise to a measurable, supportable statement.

name: Keep reviewers in control
description: Describe Inkloom AI as assisting review, not automatically approving content.

name: Add a disclaimer to performance claims
description: When an absolute or performance claim appears, include the sample disclaimer or another approved disclosure.
replacement: Add the approved disclaimer “Results may vary.”

name: Use descriptive link text
description: Avoid generic link labels such as “click here” or “read more”; describe the destination or action.
replacement: Use link text that describes the destination or action.

name: Approved logo comparison (demo only)
description: DEMO ONLY: no image upload or pixel-level logo comparison is implemented.
